content:
**The Vantage**, also known as **The Lab**, [1] is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The Vantage was a Raider camp set up as a vantage point giving a view of The Whitespring Grounds and the Ash Heap. The site is occupied by the Blood Eagles. The gang leader known as The Eye has decided to host at least one of their many interrogation sessions at the encampment, and a holotape of such must be found for the quest Sibling Piracy.

This former Raider encampment is now infested with a new gang. It comprises two lookout towers. The top of both lookout towers contain Ammo Boxes and Duffle Bags. The southern tower also has a Weapons Workbench and a Cooking Station at its base.

The Vantage appears in *Fallout 76*.
